title: La restauration des fondations du pilier de la tour de la cathédrale de Strasbourg = Die Fundamentsanierung des Turmpfeilers des Straßburger Münsters
summary: Transcribed, translated and annotated edition of the construction site diary as part of the research project "Engineering nationality" of the Université de Strasbourg and the University of Innsbruck in collaboration with the Fondation de l'Œuvre Notre-Dame in Strasbourg.
